text:
Hey everyone, question regarding multiple TZ numbers:

When my partner moved to Israel (with B1 visa), he got an Israeli driver’s license and was assigned an ID number by misrad harishuy. We later bought a scooter, and it is registered under that ID number.

Since then, he received his Israeli Teudat Zehut and A5 visa.

We’re now buying a car and are not sure which ID number we should use to register it - the old number that appears on his driver’s license, or his permanent Teudat Zehut number (that I’m not sure if misrad harishuy know of).

Has anyone been in the same situation and knows which number should be used when registering a new vehicle?

Thanks! 🙏
